Name: Main Controller
Description: Main processing unit for Wi-Fi/Bluetooth communication, data analysis, display/input management, and interface with other RF modules.

Name: OLED Display
Description: Small, low-power OLED screen for displaying network information, scan results, menus, and battery level.

Name: Up Navigation Button
Description: Tactile button for 'up' navigation in menus or parameter adjustment.

Name: Down Navigation Button
Description: Tactile button for 'down' navigation in menus or parameter adjustment.

Name: Left Navigation Button
Description: Tactile button for 'left' navigation in menus or parameter adjustment.

Name: Right Navigation Button
Description: Tactile button for 'right' navigation in menus or parameter adjustment.

Name: Select/Action Button
Description: Tactile button for 'select' or 'action' confirmation.

Name: LiPo Battery
Description: Rechargeable power source for portable operation, with voltage monitoring capability.

Name: LiPo Charging Module
Description: Manages charging of the LiPo battery from a USB 5V source and provides regulated output.

Name: 3.3V Step-Down Regulator
Description: Provides stable 3.3V power to all components from the LiPo battery output.

Name: External Wi-Fi/BT Antenna
Description: External antenna connected to the ESP32 for improved Wi-Fi and Bluetooth signal range and reliability.

Name: Sub-GHz RF Transceiver
Description: Enables communication on sub-GHz frequencies for capturing and transmitting various radio signals.

Name: NFC/RFID Module
Description: Provides Near Field Communication and RFID capabilities for interacting with compatible tags and devices.

Name: Sub-GHz Antenna
Description: Antenna specifically tuned for the 433MHz band to enhance the performance of the sub-GHz RF module.

Name: Main Enclosure Top Half
Description: Top half of the compact handheld enclosure, designed with openings for the OLED display, multiple buttons, and antenna ports.

Name: Main Enclosure Bottom Half
Description: Bottom half of the compact handheld enclosure, includes internal mounting features for electrical components and a cutout for the USB charging port.

Name: MCU Standoffs
Description: Small 3D-printed standoffs to elevate and secure the main MCU board within the enclosure.

Name: OLED Display Mount
Description: Custom frame to securely hold the OLED display in position behind its window in the top enclosure half.

Name: Button Array Frame
Description: Integrated frame to hold the five tactile buttons securely in the main enclosure top half.

Name: LiPo Battery Holder
Description: Internal tray to secure the LiPo battery and prevent movement inside the enclosure.

Name: Charger & Regulator Mount
Description: Combined mount for the LiPo charging module and the 3.3V step-down regulator.

Name: Wi-Fi/BT Antenna Port
Description: Mount to secure the external Wi-Fi/BT antenna's U.FL connector or a small panel-mount adapter to the enclosure.

Name: Sub-GHz Module Mount
Description: Mount for the Sub-GHz RF transceiver module.

Name: NFC Module Mount
Description: Mount for the NFC/RFID module, allowing it to be positioned near the enclosure surface for card interaction.

Name: Sub-GHz Antenna Port
Description: Mount to secure the external Sub-GHz antenna to the enclosure.

Name: M2 Heat-Set Inserts
Description: Brass heat-set inserts for creating robust M2 threads in 3D printed parts for component mounting.

Name: M2x4mm Pan Head Screws
Description: Small screws for attaching electrical modules (MCU, display, RF modules) to their 3D-printed mounts.

Name: M3 Heat-Set Inserts
Description: Brass heat-set inserts for creating robust M3 threads in 3D printed parts for case assembly.

Name: M3x8mm Button Head Screws
Description: Screws for assembling the top and bottom halves of the main enclosure.
